In another instance, a network disruption caused the delay of settling bank acknowledgement by 1 hour and 54 minutes. Regulation SCI events that impact core systems used in clearing that enable the acceptance and novation of trades and enable the calculation of margin and settlement obligations are assessed by Risk Management, Product Management, Regulation SCI personnel, and Legal to confirm total number of incidents and duration of failures. Incidents that do not result in a direct business impact to clients are not reported as a failure for Disclosure 17.3.
 
 
Note: On May 28, 2026 – a system disruption in trade-related activity prevented message processing from functioning as expected, resulting in delays in the timely handling of messages. Additionally, On June 29,2026 NSCC did not complete final settlement forcing a “rollover” of final settlement for June 29, 2026, into final settlement for June 30, 2026. The rollover was caused by two erroneous submitted ETF redemption transactions that were processed in downstream systems resulting in a net settlement payment obligation that NSCC was unable to reverse in a timely manner.
